blocks.text: Vice Ganda brought her signature humor and lively energy and even channeled impeachment prosecutor San Juan Rep. Ysabel Maria “Bel” Zamora as she hosted a live showdown celebrating the skills of food-service crew members on Tuesday, Oct. 6, in Taguig City. The TV host kept the program entertaining as employees showcased their question and answer skills after they went through a closed door cooking chicken competition. The competition’s question-and-answer portion took inspiration from the format of “It’s Showtime’s” popular “Miss Q&A” segment, with Vice Ganda throwing funny and witty questions at the contestants and engaging with their answers.
